limitations: Nonblocking samples can be inconsistent; 246 sampling errors are retained rather than hidden.
Only observed active GIL-held stacks are included; native work without the GIL and idle waiting are excluded.
Inclusive function counts overlap and must not be summed.
Recorded sample shares are not total CPU utilization, wall time, GPU stall or removable JCT.
Live development profiling overlaps collection; it is not an uninstrumented formal performance comparison.
